import sys, json, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tools')
from controller import run
from brute import brute
from gen import random_case
from gen2 import tight_case
from runtests3 import bigtarget_case
from runtests4 import uniform_case
import verify
from fractions import Fraction
rng=random.Random(999)
gens=[('small',lambda: random_case(rng,'small')),('tight',lambda: tight_case(rng,True)),
      ('bigtarget',lambda: bigtarget_case(rng)),('uniform',lambda: uniform_case(rng))]
bad=0; total=0
for name,g in gens:
    for i in range(120):
        case=g(); total+=1
        out=run(json.dumps({'version':3,'cases':[case]}).encode())
        if 'error' in out: print(name,i,'INVALID'); bad+=1; continue
        res=out['results'][0]
        errs=verify.check(case,res); errs=verify.check_reports(case,res,errs)
        ref=brute(case)
        got=(Fraction(res['ratio'][0],res['ratio'][1]),res['utility'],res['age'])
        if got!=(ref[0],ref[1],ref[2]): errs.append('brute mismatch %r %r'%(got,(ref[0],ref[1],ref[2])))
        if errs: bad+=1; print(name,i,errs[:4])
print('total %d failures %d'%(total,bad))
" 2>&1 | tail -4
